decisions.reason: After several years with no visible market presence, the option value of waiting is largely exhausted and this close-to-core semi-hard cheese is unlikely to justify further assortment complexity.
A multi-variant spicy cheese line is costly to keep open, and the absence of later market evidence suggests management would now prune it rather than continue carrying weak options.

Although this mild soft cheese fit the firm's core range, by 2022 the lack of continued visibility indicates enough learning has occurred to reallocate resources to stronger established products or new trials.
This washed-rind soft cheese serves a narrower taste niche, and with no subsequent signs of traction the firm would most likely abandon it and focus on better-supported core offerings.
